# Generated by tools/qpq_contracts.py from vanilla's contract weights: 15 points per point of `score`.
# Root: the subject of the contract. gain = what the one who gets it counts, cost = what the giver counts.

qpq_ct_tax_down_gain_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 1 }
		add = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 2 }
		add = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 3 }
		add = 30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 4 }
		add = 15
	}
}

qpq_ct_tax_down_cost_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 1 }
		add = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 2 }
		add = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 3 }
		add = 45
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 4 }
		add = 15
	}
}

qpq_offer_ct_tax_down_points_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_ct_tax_down_gain_value
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.25
	}
}
